header.purpose: compare the clearing account balance in the general ledger with the subledger balance for each ledger unit at month end and recommend reconciled or escalate, with the workings, for a ledger reviewer
metrics: share of ledger units recommended reconciled and confirmed by the reviewer
escalations per month end, by reason

trigger.step_up_evidence: ten runs with no missed input

drafting_boundary.entry_rung: no drafts: the recommendation and its workings only
drafting_boundary.step_up_evidence: no edits needed on most drafts

handoff_writes.next_rung: hand-off file plus a queue note

person_checkpoint.step_up_evidence: flag rate agreed with the owner

parts.input: the ledger balance report and the subledger balance report for one month end, and the in-transit list
parts.output: one recommendation per ledger unit (reconciled, escalate for a source gap, or escalate for a residual) with the workings
parts.end_point: recommendations and workings handed to the ledger reviewer; nothing is marked complete

routing.basis: a fixed script decides every outcome; the model gathers the reports, runs it and explains its result

single_part_reason: one trigger, one set of reports and one reviewer: no split reason holds

rejected_alternatives.alternative: the model decides the outcome from the reports
rejected_alternatives.why: every outcome is a fixed comparison of recorded balances; the model may add an escalation but never upgrade the script's result

rejected_alternatives.alternative: a separate checking part and a separate explaining part
rejected_alternatives.why: both read the same reports on the same trigger and hand to the same reviewer
